question: In relation to the restriction enzymes:

options.opa: The DNA fragments that result from cuts made by restriction enzymes whose ends do not contain unpaired bases are called cohesive ends.
options.opb: The target sequences of the restriction enzymes are all palindromic and 6 base pairs in length.
options.opc: The methylation of the bases prevents the binding of the restriction enzyme and, in this way, the DNA itself is not hydrolyzed.
options.opd: Restriction enzymes cut only one strand of DNA.
